llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选择性激光熔化制造仿生夹芯结构的力学性能，与生物医学植入物的制造和力学测试相关，但未直接涉及应力屏蔽或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, stress shielding, fatigue behavior, or surface roughness/osseointegration, focusing only on compressive mechanical properties of bio-inspired sandwich structures.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索仿生夹芯结构在压缩载荷下的力学性能，为轻量化设计提供依据。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化制造仿生夹芯结构，并进行准静态压缩实验。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了结构的变形模式和力学性能，包括强度、刚度和能量吸收。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试验证了结构的力学行为与设计预期一致。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to investigate the mechanical properties and deformation behavior of bio-inspired sandwich structures under compressive loading, providing insights for lightweight design.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate bio-inspired sandwich structures, and quasi-static compression tests were conducted.
summary_en.result: The deformation modes, strength, stiffness, and energy absorption characteristics of the structures were revealed.
summary_en.validation: Experimental testing validated the mechanical behavior, showing good agreement with design expectations.

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate bilayered membranous constructs for tissue engineering applications.
summary_en.method: 3D bioprinting of human cell-laden alginate/gelatin composite hydrogels into a bilayered structure.
summary_en.result: Bilayered constructs were successfully printed with maintained cell viability and structural integrity.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture assays confirmed biocompatibility and construct stability.
